biggest_catch: The $1,500 headline requires a $200,000 balance sitting in the account on day 45 — the realistic tier for most people is $500 (needs $30,000). Anyone without tens of thousands in spare cash should treat this as a $500 offer, not $1,500.
catches: Bonus is tiered: $500 for a $30,000 minimum balance, $1,500 for a $200,000 minimum balance. The route's claimed $200 low end is wrong — the minimum tier is $500.
The balance on the 45th calendar day after account opening determines the bonus — funds must be new-to-Citibank and posted within 45 days.
Offer valid for accounts opened 4/14/2026 to 10/26/2026; must enroll in the bonus offer the same day you open the account, directly from the offer page.
Only new Citi checking customers qualify; opening an account does not guarantee eligibility.
Monthly service fees apply unless waived ($250+ in Enhanced Direct Deposits avoids fees on Regular Checking).
Offer cannot be combined with other Citi checking offers; Citi may withdraw the offer.

steps: Go to the official Citi bonus page https://banking.citi.com/cbol/OM/checking/tiered/featured-offers/default.htm and confirm the offer is still live (valid for accounts opened by 10/26/2026).
Open a new Citi Regular Checking account directly from that page and enroll in the bonus offer the SAME day — opening any other way does not qualify.
Within 45 calendar days of account opening, deposit new-to-Citibank funds: at least $30,000 for the $500 tier or at least $200,000 for the $1,500 tier.
Keep that balance in place through the 45th day — the balance on day 45 determines your maximum bonus.
Keep the account open and in good standing until the bonus is paid per the offer's key-dates table.
To avoid monthly service fees, set up $250+ in Enhanced Direct Deposits or meet another fee waiver.
timing: Bonus earned after completing required activities; paid per the offer's key-dates table once the day-45 balance requirement is verified.
